name: Homura
source:
Late 30s. SHE's skilled security chief. 

The overall manager of SHE's security department. 
Though he's a big man over 190cm tall, he's surprisingly friendly and easy to talk to, and is trusted by his subordinates.

He has incredible physical abilities, able to destroy bulkheads with his bare hands, and even androids are no different from normal humans in his hands. 
Due to his position, he has come face to face with [url=/c4123]Ibuka Masaya[/url] on many occasions, who has run away with SHE's secrets.

"We're just humble watchdogs. Our job is to bark loudly, after all."

(From the game's website)
